10:00 Local Time, 09:00 GMT, 14:30 IST: The art of being mercurial comes naturally to one team. However, the other team has acquired it over the last couple of years. The similarity doesn't end there. Both have new skippers. And both of them had the tag of former skippers for sometime before being elevated to the post once again. Hello and welcome to the first Test between England and Pakistan. The venue for the first game is Headingley, Leeds!

England have won their last 6 Tests here. And the last time these two teams played here was in 2018 when England hammered Pakistan by an innings and 55 runs. So, it would be an understatement if we say England are massive favourites coming into this game.  And there is another interesting thing, England have batted second in all the 6 Tests winning two of them by an innings margin. That is how much they have enjoyed playing at Headlingley of late. We won't be surprised if they do the same again!

Teams:

Salman Agha: (On being named captain at short notice) Yeah, it was a last minute yesterday I found out I’m captaining, Babar was not available, which is very unfortunate. But yeah, we have been playing a lot of red ball cricket. We had a camp before West Indies series a month at home. So, I think we are well prepared here. (On Pakistan’s long wait for a Test series win) Yeah, whenever you go to any series, it’s always an opportunity to win a series, and we are here to think about that, and we want to win the series here, and that’s what we are here for. And today is the first day, we just have to have a good day. (On what he would have done had Pakistan won the toss) We wanted to bat first as well. (On the make-up of Pakistan’s XI) We have like seven proper batsmen, and four bowlers, three seamers and one spinner, and then I can roll my arm if we need. (On the spin option) Yeah, we have one proper spinner.

Pakistan’s last Test win in England came in June 2018, and England have won their last six Tests at Headingley, including an innings win over Pakistan in 2018. Their last defeat in Leeds came against West Indies in the 2017 summer.
